extras: Desktop only (Windows / macOS / Linux). Does not run on mobile.
problem: Important notifications, reminders, and pop-ups within Obsidian often appear in the background and go unnoticed when the user is focused on another application.

relations.evidence: A great pairing is with reminder plugins like Reminder or Tasks
